description: Tata letak untuk mode teks Muse. Latar putih (placeholder bg dari data brand), permukaan berwarna lewat block dan accent. Hanya posisi headline, subline, poin, dan footer; adegan dan gaya teks ditentukan Muse.

L1.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic

chips.where: Along the lower left, a row of three small rounded pill tags with thin {accent} outlines on {bg}

L1.prompt_template: Bold editorial social media poster in {aspect}, in the style of a modern campaign. The background is a {bg} studio backdrop with soft natural light and subtle shadows. The main visual is {subject}, shown as a realistic high-quality photograph with premium lighting and realistic materials; choose a fitting, natural scene, and keep any people natural and friendly. In the top third, a huge headline in {headline_style}, left aligned, {ink}, with the last two words highlighted by a {accent} marker-style bar behind them, reads exactly "{headline}". The subject sits in the lower two thirds, slightly right of center.
